newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes almost unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes almost unchanged.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed almost unchanged in heavier trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 603.09 from 603.22 on Monday.
Trade volume was 2.34 million dinars against 1.16 million dinars.
ICF was down 2.03 dinar to 57 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN was up 0.64 dinar to 45.8 dinars. BDET bank was down 0.45 dinar to 14.44 dinars.
UBCI and BIAT banks won 1.17 dinar each to 50.43 dinars for UBCI and to 65 dinars for BIAT bank.
